input.title: Apple and NVIDIA: Revenue Growth, Net Margin, and Main Filing Risks
input.content:
# Summary
This report compares Apple and NVIDIA on revenue growth and net margin using the stored annual financials, and summarizes the main risks each company describes in its recent 10-K risk factors. The latest values in the comparison are not for the same calendar period because the companies’ fiscal year ends are not aligned.

## Comparison
| Company | Metric | Latest value | Period end |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| Apple | Revenue growth | 6.43% per the stored FY2025 financials | 2025-09-27 |
| NVIDIA | Revenue growth | 65.47% per the stored FY2026 financials | 2026-01-25 |
| Apple | Net margin | 26.92% per the stored FY2025 financials | 2025-09-27 |
| NVIDIA | Net margin | 55.60% per the stored FY2026 financials | 2026-01-25 |

Apple’s revenue growth for FY2025 was 6.43% per the stored FY2025 financials, while NVIDIA’s was 65.47% per the stored FY2026 financials. Apple’s net margin for FY2025 was 26.92% per the stored FY2025 financials, while NVIDIA’s was 55.60% per the stored FY2026 financials.

## Apple: main risks reported in the filings
Apple says its operations and performance depend significantly on global and regional economic conditions, and adverse economic conditions can materially adversely affect its business, results of operations, financial condition and stock price [1616]. Apple also says changes or additions to its supply chain require considerable time and resources and involve significant risks and uncertainties, and that it is subject to significant supply and pricing risks because it sources some components from single or limited sources [1634].

Apple further says unfavorable legal proceedings or government investigations could materially adversely affect its business and financial condition, and that complex and changing laws and regulations worldwide expose it to potential liabilities, increased costs and other adverse effects [1657]. It also states that new business strategies, commercial relationships and acquisitions involve significant risks, including management distraction, greater-than-expected liabilities and expenses, and possible write-offs [1653].

## NVIDIA: main risks reported in the filings
NVIDIA’s risk factors summarize that failure to meet the evolving needs of its industry and markets, and competition, could adversely affect its financial results [1841]. NVIDIA also highlights long manufacturing lead times, uncertain supply and capacity availability, and dependency on third-party suppliers, each of which could create mismatches between supply and demand and harm product delivery schedules [1841].

NVIDIA says adverse economic conditions may harm its business, and it also notes that a significant amount of revenue comes from a limited number of partners and distributors, so losing or being prevented from selling to key end customers could adversely affect revenue [1700]. NVIDIA further says export restrictions, data privacy and security obligations, litigation and regulatory proceedings, and protection of intellectual property are material risk areas [1701].

## Data and limits
- Financial figures come from the stored annual financials and derived metrics, not from filings.
- Filing risk summaries come from search results for recent 10-K Risk Factors sections: Apple FY2025 and NVIDIA FY2025/FY2026 passages [1616] [1634] [1653] [1657] [1841] [1700] [1701].
- Apple and NVIDIA use different fiscal calendars, so the latest values are not directly aligned in time; Apple’s latest period end is 2025-09-27 and NVIDIA’s is 2026-01-25.
- This report is descriptive only and does not provide recommendations or price predictions.
